notes.title: Arcadie II: Cold Lands - Wishlist now!
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3541590/Arcadie_II_Cold_Lands][img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/43152107/d82c6ff1db152eceae9abe195c67a302ea73ab55.png[/img][/url]

Very happy to officially announce, on Steam, the upcoming sequel to [b]Arcadie: Second-Born[/b]!

[b]Arcadie: Cold Lands[/b] has been in development for almost two years now.

The release date is set to Q4 2025; not set in stone, but I'm very hopeful that the game will be released in October.

You can wishlist it here: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3541590/Arcadie_II_Cold_Lands]Arcadie II: Cold Lands[/url]

notes.title: Steam Trading Cards
notes.content:
[b]Steam Trading Cards for Arcadie: Second-Born are now available![/b]

Getting 3 of them is as simple as playing the game. If you've already played the game, they should have already automatically popped into your inventory.

Steam does a better job explaining how Trading Cards work, so I suggest visiting the following link should you wish to learn more: https://steamcommunity.com/tradingcards/

I've also created a set of backgrounds and emoticons ; I hope you'll enjoy unlocking and using them!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43152107/a493553bf52336792020a87e9767c274f0bc1446.png[/img]

notes.title: Patch update 1.0.5
notes.content:
Bugfixes and minor changes.
Light spoilers below!

[b]Bugfixes[/b]
[list]
[*] In chapter 14, on Cyril's route, fixed an error message that would appear if picked the option to grab their hand
[*] In chapter 16, fixed a minor misspelling
[*] In chapter 20, talking with Cyril could have an option display “$mccyril” instead of what you chose to call them
[*] In the epilogue, on Will's route, fixed an error that caused the wrong text to appear in case Nathaniel's offer was turned down
[/list]

[b]Minor changes[/b]
[list]
[*] In chapter 16, on Will's romantic route, lowered the affection threshold for the scene to proceed (65 vs 70)
[*] In chapter 20, made it clearer that turning down either Will or Cyril (if romanced) from accompanying the main character back to their quarters would signify a lack of interest and end the romance
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.content:
This update fixes an issue that, in some rare cases, could stop the game in the middle of chapter 16.

Game should now read v. 1.0.2 in the "Credits" section.
